usedFor: Linear holds issues, Trello holds cards, and “Isuue Status Updated” can start “Create Trello Card” or “Move Card to List”.

bestTemplate.name: “Isuue Status Updated” in Linear, then “Move Card to List” in Trello
bestTemplate.why: When an issue changes status in Linear, its card moves to a chosen list on a chosen board.

watchOut: Linear's only trigger here is “Isuue Status Updated”, so every Trello action runs on status changes, not on new issues.
